name: Momoiro Okami no Honoka-san ~Ikenai, O-mo-te-na-shi~
original_name: 桃色女将の穂乃香さん～イケない、お・も・て・な・し～
source:
The protagonist is a novelist. That said, he mainly writes what you’d call erotic novels.
But right now, he’s in the midst of a celebrated slump.
Determined to become a literary giant of old, he resolves to stay long-term at an inn and devote himself to writing.

And so he visits the hot spring inn “Tsuyuri.”
I can’t hide my embarrassment and anticipation at the stunning beauty of the proprietress, Honoka, who welcomed me.

I spend my days completely healed by Honoka, who treats me with such kindness, yet my pen simply won’t move at all.
At that moment, the proprietress encounters a scene where a drunk customer is bothering her.
Thanks to the protagonist's quick thinking, they were able to rescue them safely.

That night, as a thank-you for helping her, she was allowed to use the “special hot spring.”
I enjoyed the scent of peach and the smooth feel of the water, yet I found myself strangely aroused.
And then, to my surprise, Honoka-san came in saying, “I’ll wash your back.”

Apparently, this special hot spring is said to be so powerful in boosting virility that it is even called the “hot spring of fertility.”

“You can blame everything on the hot springs right now.”
She ends up becoming physically entwined with Honoka, as she is led by her sweet seduction.

When Honoka learned that the protagonist was a seno shousetsuka in a slump,
“If you can’t come up with a solution in your head, I think the best thing is to actually try it,” he says, promising to do anything, even the risqué stuff.

And so, she would end up unfolding all sorts of imagined scenarios with Honoka.

The days of the beautiful proprietress’s dazzling, alluring hospitality.
Please enjoy it to your heart's content.
